reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Added Allow users to put extra white spaces between namespaces in networking.istio.io/exportTo annotation", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: Annotations with extra white spaces between namespaces in the exportTo annotation are now accepted without failure.

proposed.statement: The networking.istio.io/exportTo annotation now accepts extra white spaces between namespaces.
